events.evidence: The Dow Jones Industrial Average drops again almost 1,000 points over coronavirus fears
British airline Flybe collapses into administration with the loss of 2,000 jobs after failing to secure financial support
The first death from COVID-19 is confirmed in England, after a woman in her 70s with underlying health conditions dies at Royal Berkshire Hospital

label.note: Equity selloff and Flybe collapse show market/credit stress; first UK COVID-19 death extends pandemic concern.
